subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should after-compaction hooks gain a core current-session reset API, and does OpenClaw intend to support the early explicit-session-key Remnic call form as a public compatibility contract?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin API and persistent session transition; repository policy requires maintainer intent rather than inferring a permanent contract from an unmerged earlier PR or a privately deployed consumer.

options.title: Current-session API only
options.body: Expose only resetSession(reason?) after successful compaction and remove the explicit-key overload because it has never shipped from OpenClaw main.

options.title: Support explicit-key compatibility
options.body: Keep a precisely documented two-argument compatibility form, align its type and implementation, and add upgrade-focused tests and real lifecycle proof.

options.title: Pause the core API
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it until maintainers decide whether compaction recovery should be owned by a different core or plugin lifecycle seam.

recommendation.title: Current-session API only
recommendation.body: Expose only resetSession(reason?) after successful compaction and remove the explicit-key overload because it has never shipped from OpenClaw main.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent agent/session lifecycle work and explicit routing in this PR make them the strongest available owner for the API-boundary decision.
